title: Who Loses, and When It Commits

scenes.tts: In a dish, the experimenter decides where support is lost. In the animal, who decides?
scenes.visual: Title card: Who Loses, and When It Commits. Two sympathetic axons reach one target releasing NGF.
scenes.narration: In a dish, the experimenter decides where support is lost. In the animal, who decides?

scenes.tts: Many sympathetic neurons send branches toward targets that make N G F. The branches compete.
scenes.caption: Many sympathetic neurons send branches toward targets that make NGF. The branches compete.
scenes.visual: Several axons converge on one target; a limited number of NGF dots.
scenes.narration: Many sympathetic neurons send branches toward targets that make NGF. The branches compete.

scenes.tts: When N G F is limited, a branch that wins enough is stabilized. One left with too little is weakened and removed.
scenes.visual: One axon thickens as it collects NGF; the other thins.
scenes.narration: When NGF is limited, a branch that wins enough is stabilized. One left with too little is weakened and removed.
scenes.caption: When NGF is limited, a branch that wins enough is stabilized. One left with too little is weakened and removed.

scenes.tts: Two receptors matter. Track A is the N G F receptor. P seventy-five binds all neurotrophins, including B D N F.
scenes.caption: Two receptors matter. TrkA is the NGF receptor. p75 binds all neurotrophins, including BDNF.
scenes.visual: Labels on the axon tips: TrkA, the NGF receptor; p75, binds all neurotrophins including BDNF.
scenes.narration: Two receptors matter. TrkA is the NGF receptor. p75 binds all neurotrophins, including BDNF.

scenes.tts: One axon has strong track A signalling, the other weak. B D N F is present. Which axon goes?
scenes.caption: One axon has strong TrkA signalling, the other weak. BDNF is present. Which axon goes?
scenes.visual: Two axons side by side: strong TrkA, weak TrkA. BDNF dots drift between them. Question mark.
scenes.narration: One axon has strong TrkA signalling, the other weak. BDNF is present. Which axon goes?

scenes.tts: The weak one. On axons with weak track A signalling, B D N F acting through p seventy-five caused degeneration.
scenes.caption: The weak one. On axons with weak TrkA signalling, BDNF acting through p75 caused degeneration.
scenes.visual: BDNF dots bind p75 on the weak axon; its tip thins and fragments. Credit: Singh, Kaplan, Miller and colleagues, 2008.
scenes.narration: The weak one. On axons with weak TrkA signalling, BDNF acting through p75 caused degeneration.

scenes.tts: Axons with strong track A signalling were protected. And the winning neurons made the B D N F.
scenes.caption: Axons with strong TrkA signalling were protected. And the winning neurons made the BDNF.
scenes.visual: The strong axon stays intact. BDNF dots appear near the weak axon; label: in one model, released by the winner.
scenes.narration: Axons with strong TrkA signalling were protected. And the winning neurons made the BDNF.

scenes.tts: So a winner does more than take the N G F. It also sends a signal that removes the loser.
scenes.caption: So a winner does more than take the NGF. It also sends a signal that removes the loser.
scenes.visual: On-screen line: the winner takes the NGF and removes the loser.
scenes.narration: So a winner does more than take the NGF. It also sends a signal that removes the loser.

scenes.tts: The neurotrophic hypothesis lesson showed the same winner-removes-loser idea for whole neurons. Here it works on axons.
scenes.visual: Two panels: whole neurons competing, then axons competing. Label: winner removes loser, at two scales.
scenes.narration: The neurotrophic hypothesis lesson showed the same winner-removes-loser idea for whole neurons. Here it works on axons.

scenes.tts: So how does an axon come apart after N G F is withdrawn? Not all at once.
scenes.visual: A deprived axon alone, with a time strip beneath it.
scenes.narration: So how does an axon come apart after NGF is withdrawn? Not all at once.
scenes.caption: So how does an axon come apart after NGF is withdrawn? Not all at once.

scenes.tts: First, the axon waits through a long latent phase. It looks nearly normal.
scenes.visual: Time strip segment one, latent: a long stretch; the axon looks unchanged.
scenes.narration: First, the axon waits through a long latent phase. It looks nearly normal.

scenes.tts: Late in latency, swellings called spheroids appear. Calcium gathers in them.
scenes.visual: Segment two, transition: beads swell along the axon and glow with calcium.
scenes.narration: Late in latency, swellings called spheroids appear. Calcium gathers in them.

scenes.tts: Then the axon fragments. That is the catastrophic phase.
scenes.visual: Segment three, catastrophic: the axon breaks into pieces.
scenes.narration: Then the axon fragments. That is the catastrophic phase.

scenes.tts: Two receptors split the work. P seventy-five is needed for spheroids to form.
scenes.caption: Two receptors split the work. p75 is needed for spheroids to form.
scenes.visual: Label on the transition segment: p75, needed for spheroid formation.
scenes.narration: Two receptors split the work. p75 is needed for spheroids to form.

scenes.tts: D R six is needed for the catastrophic degeneration that medium from deprived axons speeds up.
scenes.caption: DR6 is needed for the catastrophic degeneration that medium from deprived axons speeds up.
scenes.visual: Label on the catastrophic segment: DR6, needed for catastrophe sped by conditioned medium.
scenes.narration: DR6 is needed for the catastrophic degeneration that medium from deprived axons speeds up.

scenes.tts: The Deppmann laboratory's model is that spheroids gate the step from waiting to catastrophe. It is not yet a settled mechanism.
scenes.visual: A gate drawn at the transition between latent and catastrophic. Label: the laboratory's model.
scenes.narration: The Deppmann laboratory's model is that spheroids gate the step from waiting to catastrophe. It is not yet a settled mechanism.

scenes.tts: Where support is lost decides what is lost. In a contest, the winner helps decide too.
scenes.visual: Closing card: lost support picks the branch; in a contest, the winner helps decide.
scenes.narration: Where support is lost decides what is lost. In a contest, the winner helps decide too.
